reading: This is a hero section sketch for a 'Paper Room' zine fair site: a top nav, a large stripes card with a 'CUT' wordmark, a cluster of overlapping decorative shapes (teal clip-path cutout, peach-to-coral gradient cutout, a blue multiply-blend disc, and two pieces of yellow sticky tape), a paragraph of body copy with a 'scissors people' button, a pink circled date badge, a 'Get a table' pill button, and a wide-spaced footer line, all on an off-white Helvetica page.
